style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean clinical family-health ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty blue backdrop #AECDE0, card white #FFFFFF, deep navy text #2B3A46, tech-blue accent #1E7FE0, plus one reserved alert-red #E8452E and one night-navy #0E1B26 for emotive section screens only; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif for short headlines and labels; pale-blue rounded cards with thin-line blue icons and small pill-shaped section tags; white marble slab platforms and soft matte studio sweeps; soft diffused studio light from the upper front-left with gentle contact shadows; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle with consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no efficacy or medical claims, no real measurement numbers.
style.presentationRules: product kept at a stable slight 3/4 hero angle with consistent scale; centered infographic blocks with balanced panel spacing
style.surfaceSystem: white marble slab platform with mint accent spheres, plus matte light-grey and pale-blue studio sweeps
